_note: Risk Reporting thresholds (AUR-J-RISK-001, WS-2.3). Consolidates the portfolio-level risk bands that previously lived scattered across server.py INITIAL config and the mandate fixture. These are the PORTFOLIO-MONITORING bands used by the periodic Risk Reporting agent — distinct from the PRE-TRADE enforcement caps in pretrade_structuring.MANDATE_LIMITS (e.g. max_single_position_pct 0.15), which block an individual trade at entry. Reporting aggregates standing risk; gating blocks a bad trade. Complementary, not redundant. Editing this fixture is a doctrine event (fixtures are doctrine). Values sourced 2026-07-04 from server.py (drawdown/position bands) and mandate_fixture.json (sector, cash floor).
